Svitzer offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to how we strengthen our commercial capabilities across a global organisation. We have ambitious growth plans, which you will support as the Commercial Excellence Partner.

Further, you will drive the development and implementation of commercial processes, tools and insights that help our commercial teams perform at their best. Working with colleagues across regions, you will help turn commercial priorities into practical ways of working that strengthen customer focus and support profitable growth.

You will be part of the Global Commercial Team and work closely with commercial colleagues across our four regions, as well as colleagues across Operations, Finance, Strategy and other Global Functions. The role is based in our Headquarters in Nordhavn, Copenhagen, and you will report to the Head of Commercial Excellence & Commercial Operations.

**About Us

**Svitzer is a leading global towage operator with 4,500 colleagues and a fleet of 510 vessels operating across more than 35 countries. Every day, we help keep ports open, terminals operating and global trade moving through safe, reliable and increasingly sustainable marine services. If you would like to see our tugboats in action and learn more, visit our website and watch this short video: Svitzer Introduces TRAnsverse Tug.

**What We Offer

**At Svitzer, we are a truly people-centric company with safety at our core, driven to innovate and succeed together, with our customers’ interests in focus.

You will become part of an ambitious global organisation where commercial drive and accountability go hand in hand with collaboration across cultures. You will be encouraged to take ownership and have the opportunity to help shape the role in our fairly new team. We offer flexible ways of working and room to develop.

**Responsibilities

**In this role, you will:

• Drive the implementation of Svitzer’s Commercial Excellence agenda, helping translate commercial priorities into practical frameworks, tools and ways of working.

• Support the development and continuous improvement of commercial processes, tools and methodologies that enable consistent and effective commercial execution.

• Run Svitzer’s annual NPS process, including gathering and analysing input and helping translate customer feedback into relevant actions.

• Drive the Key Customer Programme for Svitzer, which entails establishing best practices for our main key accounts.

• Support commercial planning, customer segmentation and performance management across regions.

• Help strengthen commercial capabilities through training, knowledge-sharing and practical support to regional and local commercial teams.

• Analyse commercial data, insights and performance measures and use these to support commercial decision-making.

• Contribute to the development of customer value propositions and commercial approaches that reflect customer needs and Svitzer’s strategic priorities.

• Work with regional and local commercial teams to support the adoption of common tools and processes, while recognising different market needs.

• Facilitate knowledge-sharing and exchange of commercial best practices across regions.

• Identify and suggest improvements to how we collaborate with a focus on simplicity, customer value and effective execution.

**Who We Are Looking For

**We are looking for a commercially minded professional with strong analytical skills and an interest in developing how commercial teams work and perform. You probably have 5–7 years of experience in a commercial role.

You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across functions, regions and cultures and are comfortable working on several initiatives and stakeholder relationships at the same time. You combine analytical thinking with a practical mindset and enjoy turning ideas and insights into solutions that can be used in the business.

**In Particular, We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings

**

• A valid work and residence permit for Denmark (this is a must).

• Good business and commercial understanding, including an understanding of how customer needs can turn into commercial outcomes.

• Relevant experience from Commercial Excellence, business development, commercial operations, pricing, sales effectiveness or a related area.

• Experience working with or improving commercial processes, tools and frameworks.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data and insights into clear conclusions and recommendations.

• Good project-management and coordination skills.

• The ability to build effective working relationships with diverse stakeholders.

• A pragmatic and collaborative approach and an ability to make complex topics practical and understandable.

• Good communication and presentation skills.

• Experience from an international organisation is an advantage.

• Fluency in English.

You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. We value diverse experiences and are interested in your motivation, potential and ability to grow in the role.

**How To Apply

**To ensure a consistent and fair recruitment process, please submit your CV and a motivational letter via the “Apply” button on our Svitzer Careers page. Applications submitted outside the system cannot be considered. Please leave out information about age, gender, religion or other factors not related to the role. A photo is not required.

**Deadline

**The deadline for your application is 30 November 2026. However, we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the job advertisement earlier if we receive a strong field of qualified candidates.

**Questions

**To ensure a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we will not respond to questions in advance of interviews. Relevant questions can be addressed during the interview process.

**Building a Diverse Workplace

**In Svitzer we value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job – we value diversity in all its forms, including but not limited to gender, age, nationality, race, sexual orientation, disability, or religious beliefs. We are proud of our diversity and see it as a genuine source of strength for building high performing teams.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that members from some under-represented groups are less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every single qualification. At Svitzer we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles, and we are excited about hearing from you!

**How To Apply

**To apply for this role, please click on the 'Apply Now' button and create a Candidate Home to manage your applications.

**The Impact You'll Make

**We’re Looking For Two Student Workers To Join Our Engineering & RD&E Excellence Team. Our Job Is To Make Work Simpler, More Consistent And More Effective For Danfoss’ Global Engineering Organization.There Are Two Positions With Different Focus Areas

Process & Governance Support: for you who likes structure, clear documentation and working with people across the organization.

PDM Digital & AI Support: for you who likes to code, automate and build practical AI solutions for our global Product Data Management (PDM) team.

Both positions are on the same curious, open team. Your ideas are welcome here, and your work will be used by colleagues around the world.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You’ll work with colleagues across our global RD&E organization. In both positions, success means delivering practical work that colleagues can use, building good relationships across countries, and turning feedback into real improvements. In the PDM Digital & AI position, it also means building reliable, well-documented solutions for the global PDM team.

Process & Governance Support

• Review and update process descriptions, documentation, meeting templates and working standards

• Coordinate feedback and reach out to stakeholders across functions and locations

• Explore how AI can make our ways of working simpler and more efficient

• Work closely with process owners, meeting owners, specialists and senior stakeholders

PDM Digital & AI Suppor

• Write code and build small digital tools, automations and AI-based solutions

• Work with users in the global PDM team to understand their challenges and make sure your solutions meet real needs

• Test, improve and document the solutions you build

• Work closely with the global PDM team across functions and locations

**What We're Looking For

**

• You’re enrolled in a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s program and can work as a student worker in Denmark

• You speak and write English fluently, and you work independently and take ownership of your tasks

• You enjoy working with international colleagues and reaching out to stakeholders at all levels

• For Process & Governance: structured, comfortable with documentation, and confident reaching out to stakeholders at different seniority levels.

• For PDM Digital & AI: interest in programming, automation, and AI, ideally through studies in software engineering, computer science, data science, engineering, digitalization, or a related field.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

_Apply AI to healthcare challenges that matter. Join our Innovation team in Aarhus for a hands-on internship where you'll develop AI solutions that support clinical decision-making for healthcare professionals worldwide.

_**Expected start:

February 2027

**The internship You'll work on real AI challenges in healthcare, contributing to developing features that help clinicians make better decisions. From data exploration to model analysis, you'll experience the full data science workflow and see your work integrated into products that improve patient care across hospitals and communities.

Your key responsibilities include:

• developing and experimenting with ML/AI models for healthcare products, working with areas such as natural language processing, speech recognition, or translation.

• assisting in prompt engineering and working with large language models (LLMs)

• processing, analysing, and visualising data of different shapes and sizes

• contributing to model evaluation, documentation, and testing

• collaborating with data scientists, ML engineers, architects, product managers, and domain experts

• participating in technical sparring sessions and code reviews

**Join our Innovation team in Healthcare

**Our Healthcare Innovation team sits at the heart of Systematics' mission to support healthcare professionals in critical environments. We develop AI solutions that simplify decision-making for users of our Columna platform worldwide. You'll join six colleagues - data scientists, architects and developers - who are eager to share their knowledge and explore what AI can achieve in healthcare. The team thrives on informal communication, mutual trust and genuine curiosity. We also enjoy coffee breaks, plenty of cake and laughs, and occasional matches on our padel court.

**Your Qualifications

**You are pursuing a MSc in Data Science, Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Cognitive Science, Statistics, or similar, and you have:

• practical experience with Python, working with data analysis and statistical/ML modelling using e.g. Tensorflow/Transformers

• understanding of LLMs and prompt engineering – you have experimented with large language models and understand their potential applications

• experience developing or implementing machine learning models – you have built models from data preprocessing through to evaluation

• you understand data handling, model evaluation, the visualisation of data-driven solutions and the development of best practices.

• appreciate teamwork and has good communication skills

• you speak and write English fluently as it is our corporate language. It is also an advantage if you can speak Danish, but this is not a requirement.

• knowledge of Docker and FastAPI is not required, but is an advantage

The internship is a full-time position lasting five months, commencing on 1 February 2027. The position is unpaid; however, if permitted by your academic programme, you will receive a monthly token of appreciation during your internship.

To be eligible, you must be enrolled in a Danish study program and be based in Denmark during the internship period.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues eager to share their knowledge, while being entrusted with real responsibility early in your journey.

We believe in delivering high-quality solutions while maintaining a positive work environment – whether through shared laughter over coffee, engaging discussions, or meaningful connections with colleagues. Beyond your immediate team, you will join our intern network, where you can build relationships and participate in social events with other interns across the organization.

Are you motivated by ensuring smooth execution while leading a dedicated team and collaborating with customers, production sites, warehouse partners, and transport providers?

“We are looking for a Logistics Operations Manager to lead and develop the Danish 3PL warehouse and transport setup. The role focuses on operational performance management with a future potential for strategic and tactical network warehouse design,” says Janni Jepsen, Director for Warehouse & Outbound Logistics.

**How You Will Make An Impact

**As Logistics Operations Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing logistics operations and leading a small team in a complex environment where customer requirements, warehouse execution, transportation, and production planning must come together seamlessly. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading and developing a small operational team

• Owning and developing performance across both 3PL warehousing and 3PL transportation

• Developing robust decision material and recommendations for 3PL partner decisions

• Ensuring high customer service levels and operational reliability

• Coordinating activities across production sites, logistics providers, customers, and commercial teams

• Monitoring and improving key performance indicators such as service level, completion rate, inventory accuracy, productivity, and cost

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives across processes and systems

• Managing operational escalations and resolving supply chain challenges proactively

• Ensuring compliance with quality, food safety, and safety standards

**What Will Make You Successful

**We are looking for a candidate who combines strong operational understanding with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries. You bring a strategic and analytical mindset and can turn network insights into practical changes and measurable business improvements. You likely have:

• Experience from logistics, supply chain, warehousing, transportation, or operations management

• Experience with 3PL management across both warehousing and transportation

• Experience with strategic or tactical logistics network design, capacity planning, and implementation of network changes

• A strong understanding of the end-to-end value chain from production to customer delivery

• Experience leading teams directly or through external partners

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate across functions

• A structured and data-driven approach to performance management

• Experience with operational KPIs and continuous improvement methodologies

• The ability to prioritize and make decisions in a fast-paced environment

• Strong communication skills in English; Danish is an advantage

**What We Offer

**In this role, you will have a unique opportunity to influence the performance of a critical logistics operation and work closely with stakeholders across the entire supply chain.

You will join a collaborative and ambitious environment where development, ownership, and continuous improvement are key drivers of success. The role offers significant exposure across operations, logistics, production, and customer-facing functions, making it an excellent opportunity for further career growth within supply chain and operations leadership.

**Would you like to join us?

**If you are motivated by leading people, driving operational performance, and creating value across the supply chain, we would love to hear from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been identified. If you have any questions contact Janni Jepsen, Director for Warehouse & Outbound Logistics, on JANNI.JEPSEN@ARLAFOODS.COM.

**Shape the Future of Dairy

**Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

$26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re hiring a Product Owner to build products that compliance teams at banks and payment companies rely on every day, in more than 15 countries. You’ll work across the core of the spektr platform, from onboarding and monitoring to investigations, where our AI agents are taking on work that used to take analysts hours.

You will shape what compliance looks like when AI agents do most of the work. You’ll prototype, put ideas in front of compliance teams early, and work with engineering and design to ship what holds up in a regulated environment. You’ll do it at a Series A startup that moves fast, with the autonomy to take an idea from a blank page to a product running at banks and payment companies.

This is a chance to help define how compliance gets done, not to digitise the way it’s always been done.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Prototype fast and test with real users. Build working prototypes, often with AI tools, and put them in front of compliance and operations teams at banks and payment companies in days rather than months. Keep what works and drop what doesn’t.

• Explore several ways to solve a problem before committing to one, and come back with a clear view on which gives users the best experience, and why.

• Shape the product experience with our designers. Make complex compliance workflows simple to use, so analysts spend their time on decisions, not on the tool.

• Push how far AI can go in compliance. Our customers are regulated institutions, so every automated decision has to be explainable and defensible. You’ll work out what our AI agents can take on, what a human still needs to review, and what it takes for a compliance team to trust the result, then move that line further with each release.

• Turn customer requests into platform capabilities. When a customer asks for something specific, find the version that solves their problem and fits into the existing platform, so it stays configurable and works for the next customer too.

• Work hand in hand with engineering in Copenhagen and Iași. Align on what we’re building and why, agree how it fits the platform’s direction, and make the calls that keep work moving.

• Learn from the field. Work with our implementation team, who sit on site with customers and see every rough edge first, and use what they and our production data show you to decide what to improve.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• You’ve owned product on a B2B platform and can show us what you built, how you tested it with users and what changed as a result. Experience in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry is a plus.

• You build with AI. AI tools are part of how you prototype, research and explore ideas every day, and you have a view on how AI is changing the way products get made.

• Hands-on and fast. You’d rather show a working prototype than describe one, and you’re comfortable putting early work in front of users to learn quickly.

• Strong product and UX instincts. You can take a complex workflow and make it feel simple, and explain why one design works better than another.

• A platform thinker. When a customer asks for something, you look for the solution that fits the existing platform and scales beyond that one customer.

• Technical enough to go deep with engineers. You understand how systems, data and APIs fit together, and engineers want you in the room when decisions get made.

• Opinionated and open. You have a clear view on how things should work, argue for it, and change your mind when users or evidence show you otherwise.

• Close to customers by instinct. You’d rather sit in on a call with a bank’s onboarding team than read a summary of it.

Your route into product might have been through engineering, design, data, solutions architecture or operations. We’re interested in what you’ve built, how you think, and how quickly you learn. Prior compliance experience is a plus but isn’t a requirement.

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking a Structural Engineer Consultant to support Wind Turbine (WTG) and Balance of Plant (BoP) engineering on offshore wind projects, with a focus on Wind Turbine Components, jacket foundation design, scour and scour protection, and cable mechanical engineering.

Introducing the WTG & BoP Engineering Team

You will become part of our WTG & BoP Engineering team, where we work collaboratively to support renewable energy projects around the world. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of WTG & BoP Engineering and work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As a Structural Engineer Consultant, you will contribute to the successful development, construction, and operation of our clients’ wind projects. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting End of Warranties activities, technical due diligence, and asset management topics for clients throughout the development, construction, and operational phases of wind farms.

• Providing engineering expertise across both WTG and BoP systems, including turbine components, jacket foundations, scour protection, inter-array and export cables, offshore substations, and associated infrastructure.

• Leading the engineering activities related to foundation, scour protection, and cable work packages for offshore wind projects, from development and procurement through construction and into operations.

• Acting as a trusted technical advisor on jacket foundation design and scour management, reviewing foundation and scour protection solutions from design basis through detailed design, installation, and monitoring to ensure safe, robust, and cost-effective performance.

• Providing cable mechanical engineering support, including inter-array and export cable routing, burial and protection, cable protection systems, crossings, and the cable - foundation interface.

• Identifying, assessing, and mitigating technical risks related to turbine components, foundations, scour, cables, and asset integrity, and maintaining the project technical risk register.

• Following up on the certification process and managing interfaces with certification bodies to ensure that designs and deliverables meet the relevant standards and requirements.

• Contributing to the development of best practices and knowledge sharing across PEAK Wind’s offshore engineering services.

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Mechanical, Structural, Civil, Geotechnical, or Offshore Engineering, or similar.

• A minimum of 5 years post-education professional experience in offshore wind, the wider offshore industry, or another complex environment.

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written.

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross - functional team.

• Solid understanding of WTG components, including their function, common failure modes, and repair methodologies

• Solid understanding of the offshore wind foundation design process, particularly for jacket structures, including the impact of scour and the design of scour protection.

• Knowledge of subsea cable systems and cable mechanical engineering, such as burial and protection, cable protection systems, crossings, and the cable - foundation interface.

• Good knowledge of offshore wind EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) as well as O&M (Operations and Maintenance), including how design and installation choices affect long - term operation of the asset.

• Familiarity with offshore wind industry standards and certification frameworks, such as DNV standards, IEC, IECRE, and Eurocodes.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

**Spirii is looking for an Engineering Manager!

**If you are passionate about cutting-edge software development technologies, leading agile teams, the EV industry, and creating outstanding products, join Spirii’s fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

**The Job

**Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working. As Engineering Manager, you lead 1-2 of our engineering teams of 6–12 engineers and are accountable for making it a high-performing team. You own the people, the health of the team and the soundness of its engineering. You do this through others: Tech Leads and Senior Engineers guide the technical work day-to-day, and you make sure good decisions get made, quality stays high, and the team keeps getting better.

Spirii is adopting agentic development as the way we build software. AI agents are becoming part of how our engineers design, code, test, review and operate systems. You'll make it real in your team, working with colleagues across engineering to shape how we do it.

You work very closely with a Product Manager and a Designer. Product owns what we build and why; you own how well the team delivers it. You report to the Head of Engineering.

**What You Will Do

****Lead and grow your people

**

• Own the full people cycle for your team: hiring, onboarding, one-on-ones, feedback, career development, performance reviews and handling underperformance early and fairly.

• Build a team where people trust each other, take ownership and do their best work at a sustainable pace.

• Help your engineers grow, including senior engineers stepping into technical leadership.

**Own team performance

**

• Be accountable for the team's delivery, predictability and quality, and for how it improves over time.

• Define with Product what good looks like, and track it with evidence such as delivery flow, reliability, and team health, not gut feeling.

• Turn priorities into clear commitments, make trade-offs visible, and protect the team so committed work gets finished.

**Lead the shift to agentic development in your team

**

• Make agentic development part of how your team works every day, moving beyond individual experiments to shared practice.

• Adapt how work flows through your team as agents take on more of the building. That includes how work is specified, how code is reviewed and how quality is assured.

• Apply shared practices for quality, security and data handling as they develop, and stay accountable for what your team ships.

• Work with colleagues across engineering on how we adopt agentic development. Bring your team's needs and feedback, and help test and roll out new tools and practices.

• Track what agentic development changes for your team's delivery and quality, and share what you learn with other teams.

**Ensure sound engineering

**

• Be accountable for the quality of your team's engineering decisions, including architecture, security, operational readiness, observability and technical debt, while your Tech Lead and engineers lead the design work.

• Make sure what the team ships is tested, observable and ready to run in production, and that incidents lead to real learning.

• Work with other Engineering Managers and Tech Leads to keep our platform and practices coherent across teams.

**Collaborate across Spirii

**

• Partner with Product, Design, other departments and external consultants to align priorities and resolve dependencies.

• Communicate clearly and early about progress, risks and trade-offs.

**Who You Are

**

• You care about people and want to build teams that grow, thrive and deliver.

• You hold a high bar for quality and for yourself, and you take ownership of results.

• You're genuinely excited about AI as the new way to build software. You want to be ahead of the curve, and you're curious about where it goes next.

• You're technical enough to challenge a design, read an incident and spot risk, even if you're not writing production code day to day.

• You communicate clearly with engineers, product people and leadership alike.

**Qualifications

**The ideal candidate has relevant experience with development of digital cloud-based solutions in an agile start-up environment and can take the responsibility for leading a team of developers.

We further look for a candidate with the following experience and personal traits:

• Relevant technical graduate degree at minimum bachelor level (engineer).

• 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager with direct reports, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

• A background as a software engineer (backend or full-stack) building cloud-based solutions.

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, such as microservices and APIs, and what it takes to run them reliably in production.

• Experience improving engineering practices like automated testing, CI/CD, observability or incident management.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics or similar ways of measuring delivery.

• Experience making senior engineers and tech leads more effective, rather than doing their work for them.

**It's an advantage if you have

**

• Experience leading a team's adoption of AI-assisted or agentic development, including changing practices, not just introducing tools.

• Experience with AWS and containerised workloads.

• Experience from eMobility products.

• Experience leading a team through organisational change.

jobs.occupation: PhD Scholarship in Nonlinear Nanophotonics: Trapping Light for Extreme Light–Matter Interactions - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
Are you an experimental physicist eager to push light–matter interaction to its extremes? 

We offer a PhD scholarship at DTU Electro, where you will trap light in nanoscale optical cavities coupled to highly nonlinear 2D materials, and control them to let light interact with light far more strongly than conventional devices allow.

To trap and release light on demand, we use photonic crystal cavities in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), whose strong electro-optic effect allows fast electrical control. Our team has recently demonstrated ultracompact TFLN cavities used as modulators [1], with electrically controllable coupling to waveguides [2], and as multiport switches [3]. The project builds on these results and shares fabrication efforts with our collaborators at Harvard University, who pioneered the TFLN platform [4].

Photons interact only through a material nonlinearity, and in conventional static cavities the interaction time is fundamentally bounded, which dynamically coupled cavities can overcome [5]. You will combine such cavities with atomically thin 2D semiconductors with exceptionally strong nonlinearities to explore a largely uncharted dynamic regime of nonlinear optics, aiming to generate quantum states of light, such as squeezed light, at ultralow energies. The project is part of the Center for Nanophotonics (NanoPhoton), a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation.

Responsibilities and qualifications
You will drive the experimental work in the project from device design to demonstration, working closely with PhD students, postdocs, and senior researchers at DTU and our collaborators at Harvard University. Depending on your interests, you will have the opportunity to:

• Design photonic crystal cavities and circuits using electromagnetic and multiphysics simulations.
• Fabricate devices in DTU Nanolab’s state-of-the-art cleanroom.
• Integrate 2D materials with photonic chips.
• Characterize devices using high-speed electro-optic, pulsed-laser, and quantum-optical measurements.
• Compare your experiments with theoretical models of cavity dynamics.
• Present your results at international conferences and in leading journals.
You are curious and driven, enjoy hands-on laboratory work, and take ownership of the progress and quality of your work.

Required qualifications:

• A strong background in optics or photonics.
• Experimental experience in optics or photonics, e.g., from your master’s project.
• Programming experience in Python.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Desired qualifications:

• Nanofabrication or integrated photonics.
• Nonlinear or quantum optics, or 2D materials.
Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
Assessment of the candidates will be carried out by Associate Professor Mikkel Heuck and Professor Jesper Mørk.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Mikkel Heuck (mheu@dtu.dk).

You can read more about our department at www.electro.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 8 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

You will join a research team at DTU Electro that is part of NanoPhoton, an interdisciplinary center that brings together several DTU departments. NanoPhoton is a highly collaborative and international community of PhD students, postdocs, senior researchers and professors, where theorists and experimentalists work side by side. We value curiosity, openness and helping each other. Questions are always welcome, and experienced colleagues will help you get started in the laboratory and cleanroom.

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department, we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

In particular, on the development of novel protocols for generating and controlling macroscopic states in optomechanical systems, quantifying their macroscopicity, and exploiting them for precision sensing and for exploring the limits of quantum theory and potentially probing quantum gravity.
